title: Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.32776v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseli

translated_title: 通过动作的对比识别来学习世界模型
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型能够基于离线视觉数据进行目标导向的规划，但仅靠预测本身并不能明确其表示应当保留哪些与动作相关的区分信息。逆动力学提供了辅助监督，然而均方误差的动作回归只能通过条件动作均值的变化来奖励额外信息。我们提出了动作对比识别方法（Contrastive Identification of Actions, CIA），该方法在从以历史为条件的行为提议中采样的备选动作之间识别实际执行的动作。在同一情境下比较合理的动作，可以针对性地获取下一个潜变量超越历史所提供的信息。在精确行为匹配的条件下，我们证明了CIA能够奖励那些不会改变最优逆回归误差的动作信息，并通过一个受控学习示例验证了这一区别。CIA相比基础世界模型和回归式逆动力学基线，在规划器平均成功率上取得了更高的表现。
tldr: 本文提出动作对比识别方法CIA，通过在情境合理的备选动作中识别实际执行的动作来学习世界模型，能够捕捉逆动力学回归无法奖励的动作信息，从而提升离线视觉规划的平均成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which learns world models by identifying the executed action among contextually plausible alternatives, rewarding action information that inverse-dynamics regression cannot capture and improving planner-averaged success on offline visual planning.
